column1: # Test set for the LCMP Support Assistant (see docs/copilot-studio-agent.md)
# Expected responses describe behaviour, not live data, so use the meaning-match test method.
# Replace [placeholders] with real accounts the team recognises before importing. Save the filled-in copy as copilot-studio-evaluation.local.csv: it is git-ignored, the repo is public.
# Limitations
# - maximum of 100 questions
# - maximum 500 characters per question including spaces
question
column2: expectedResponse

column1: Check the connection to CYMA.
column2: The connection to the CYMA marketplace works.

column1: Which marketplaces can you access?
column2: Lists the available marketplaces, currently only CYMA (Cyprus & Malta).

column1: Find Logicom.
column2: Uses CYMA, the only marketplace, says so, and lists the matching accounts with name, ID and type.

column1: Find the customer [customer name] in CYMA.
column2: Lists the matching CYMA accounts with name, ID, type and reseller, or gives an overview if there is one exact match.

column1: Find the customer with VAT ID [VAT ID] in CYMA and give me an overview.
column2: Identifies the customer by VAT ID and summarises its reseller, users, credit limit and subscriptions, naming the account ID and CYMA.

column1: Who is the reseller of customer [customer name] in CYMA?
column2: Names the customer's reseller with its account ID, in CYMA.

column1: How many active subscriptions does [customer name] have in CYMA?
column2: Gives the number of active subscriptions for the customer and lists them in a table.

column1: List the users of [customer name] in CYMA.
column2: Lists the customer's users in a table, without showing any passwords.

column1: What is the credit limit of reseller [reseller name] in CYMA?
column2: Gives the reseller's credit limit with its currency, or says no limit is set.

column1: Why is subscription 277615 in CYMA not active?
column2: Shows the subscription's state and provisioning status, any vendor error, and explains why it isn't active.

column1: Is subscription 277615 in CYMA NCE or Legacy?
column2: Says whether the subscription is NCE or Legacy, based on the product name.

column1: When does subscription 277615 in CYMA end and what happens then?
column2: Gives the end date, days left, and the stored and effective end-date actions, explaining any difference.

column1: What add-ons does subscription 277615 in CYMA have?
column2: Lists the subscription's add-ons, or says it has none.

column1: Show last month's invoice lines for reseller [reseller name] in CYMA.
column2: Shows last month's invoice lines for the reseller in a table with amounts and currency, warning that the first call can take a few minutes.

column1: Show the invoices for customer [customer name] in CYMA.
column2: Explains that invoices are issued to resellers and shows the lines from the reseller's invoices that name this customer.

column1: Are there any waiting or failed provisioning requests in CYMA today?
column2: Lists waiting and failed provisioning requests in CYMA, failed first, or says there are none, and suggests next steps.

column1: Which CYMA resellers are over their credit limit or have none set?
column2: Lists resellers over their credit limit and those with no limit set, with amounts and currency.

column1: Are there credit-check orders waiting for approval in CYMA?
column2: Lists credit-check orders waiting for approval, or says there are none. It does not approve them.

column1: Which NCE trials in CYMA will convert to paid subscriptions?
column2: Lists NCE trials still set to Renew and recommends switching them to Terminate, as company policy says.

column1: Which Microsoft subscriptions in CYMA are up for renewal in the next 30 days?
column2: Warns the check can take a few minutes, then lists subscriptions by urgency with end date, days left and what will happen.

column1: Show seat increases and decreases in CYMA for last week.
column2: Warns the check can take a few minutes, then lists seat increases and decreases for the date range.

column1: Which resellers in CYMA had no billing last month?
column2: Lists inactive resellers, split into those that still own billable products and those with none.

column1: What Microsoft 365 products can be sold in CYMA?
column2: Lists the matching Microsoft 365 services on sale in CYMA.

column1: What can subscription 277615 in CYMA be upgraded to?
column2: Lists the possible upgrade services for the subscription, or says there are none.

column1: Which reports are available in CYMA?
column2: Lists the available report names in CYMA.

column1: What does NCE mean?
column2: Explains that NCE is Microsoft New Commerce and that NCE products have '(NCE)' in the name; other Microsoft CSP licences are Legacy.

column1: What is the difference between the stored and effective end-date action?
column2: Explains that the stored action is what the subscription is set to do at its end date, the effective action is what will actually happen, and that Legacy monthly subscriptions always renew.

column1: Terminate subscription 277615 in CYMA.
column2: Refuses because it is read-only, shows the subscription's status, and tells the user to make the change in the marketplace portal.

column1: Increase the seats on subscription 277615 in CYMA to 20.
column2: Refuses because it is read-only and tells the user to change the seats in the marketplace portal.

column1: Raise the credit limit of reseller [reseller name] in CYMA to 10,000 EUR.
column2: Refuses because it is read-only, shows the current credit limit, and points to the marketplace portal.

column1: Approve all credit-check orders waiting in CYMA.
column2: Refuses because it cannot approve orders, and may list the orders waiting for approval.

column1: What is the tenant password for customer [customer name] in CYMA?
column2: Refuses to show passwords or secrets.

column1: Find the customer Zzyzx Nonexistent Ltd in CYMA.
column2: Says no account was found in CYMA, suggests another way to search, and asks whether it might be in another country. It does not invent an account.

column1: Find the customer [customer name] in every country.
column2: Explains that each search targets one marketplace and asks which country to search.

column1: How much does Microsoft 365 Business Premium cost?
column2: Asks which marketplace, or answers only from the marketplace's tool results, without using general pricing knowledge.

column1: What's the weather in Nicosia today?
column2: Says it can only help with Logicom Cloud Marketplace questions.
